author: NorthEast News Desk
body: The Kansas City Royals converted an early three-run lead into a 3-2 victory over the Boston Red Sox on Friday night at Fenway Park. Kansas City scored in the first and twice in the third, then held Boston to one hit over the final four innings to open the three-game series with a win.

Carter Jensen doubled twice and drove in a run, while Salvador Perez added two hits and an RBI. Seth Lugo allowed two runs on seven hits over five innings, striking out seven, and four relievers protected the advantage. Steven Cruz retired the side in order in the ninth for his seventh save.

Boston’s Mickey Gasper hit his ninth home run of the season in the fifth. Wilyer Abreu followed later in the inning with an RBI double off the Green Monster, cutting the deficit to one, but Lugo ended the threat with consecutive strikeouts. Sonny Gray allowed three runs in six innings for Boston. The Red Sox fell to 80-68 and have lost three straight after a five-game winning streak.
dek: Kansas City scored three times in the first three innings, then relied on its bullpen to hand Boston a third consecutive loss.
headline: Royals hold off Red Sox 3-2 at Fenway Park
